I've finished T-DG5-BE-A, and every acceptance check exits 0 on the final tree. My changes are uncommitted in `/home/user/wt/dg5-be-a` (branch `dg5/be-a`, base `7344b25`). The run took 00:10:58Z to 01:32:01Z, about 81 minutes, so nothing was split.

**Checks** (logs in `docs/delivery/handbacks/DG5/T-DG5-BE-A-evidence/`):

| Check | Exit | Result |
|---|---|---|
| `validate.mjs --historical --stage DG4`, at start and at end | 0 / 0 | `PASS gate DG4 (historical)` |
| `pnpm -r typecheck`, `pnpm -r build`, `pnpm lint`, `pnpm openapi:lint` | 0 each | openapi: 690 operations, contract unchanged |
| prettier `--check` over all tracked and untracked files | 0 | all formatted |
| `pnpm test`, locale unset | 0 | 1615 / 1358 / 259 passed, 2 skipped (skipped by design, as before) |
| `pnpm test`, `C.UTF-8` | 0 | same counts |
| `with-pg.sh pnpm test:integration` (ports 23810–23849) | 0 | 210 files, 2030/2030 tests (was 1985) |

Earlier failures, all fixed before the final runs and described in the handback:
- My first locale-unset `pnpm test` exited 1 with three failures, all from my registry changes: the module list in `server.test.ts`, the dependency list in `reporting.test.ts`, and a lock-class number I'd written in a comment.
- Two targeted integration runs failed: my test fixture wrote through the app role instead of the owner role, and two of my own assertions were wrong.
- The architecture test failed once because of an empty `.claude/.cc-writes` directory. I removed it, as the assignment says.

**What I delivered:**
- **Module registry:** the five new P5 modules (forms, procedures, automation, launch, health) are registered, each with its own test suite. Every other P5 owner's route file exists as an empty stub with its registration line in place. There are also worker queue/handler stubs and a contract-test exercise file for each of the 27 backend tasks.
- **Wiring in `server.ts`:** one shared configuration resolver is created and passed into the methodology module. The automation action registry is a marked comment for BE-H to fill in.
- **Slice A core:** the configuration resolver, the per-kind registry, the content hash, drafts, resolved elements and pins, all in `methodology/`. The database guard mappings use the exact refusal codes and texts from the ADRs.
- **Operations:** all 8 BE-A operations are routed and exercised, and `p5-pending-be-a.ts` is now empty.
- **Tests:** a new integration suite, `studio-drafts.test.ts` (18 tests), covers every test item in §A.1. That includes 403 for AUD, TO and BO on writes, 428/409 on `If-Match`, one audit event per row written, and authorization re-checked at commit time for create, update and discard.

**Decisions for the orchestrator** (handback §3–§5):
- **Count pin:** the request-body count in `contract.test.ts` goes from `[323,322,1]` to `[325,324,1]` (create and update draft have JSON bodies). No other pinned count changed.
- **Element resolution:** a version's row overrides the catalogue value field by field, so a partial row keeps the other catalogue values. ADR-0039 §2 says "V's row when it exists", so reviewers may want to confirm this reading.
- **ADM_METHOD reads pins** through an organization-level grant. Its role doesn't apply to individual transformations, so without this it would get 404, which would contradict D-143 point 6.
- **Kinds without a version 1** (form_schema, procedure, automation_rule_set, health_check_scheme) are left out of the pins list until their slice registers a default key.
- **Discarding a draft that is under review** also withdraws its pending review request, with an audit event. BE-B3 still has to close that review's work items.
- **DG4 test files I touched:** `server.test.ts` and `reporting.test.ts`, one pin each, both caused by the registry change.

**Not done by me:**
- The ADR-0039/0040 problem codes have no en/ar translations in the web app yet; that file belongs to FE-A.
- The admin text "Methodology, forms, workflows, automation and branding settings are planned for later releases." is still true, since I shipped no screens. FE-B needs to change it when the Studio screens ship.
- No migration, dependency or contract change was needed.

**Files at the worktree root that aren't mine** and shouldn't be integrated: `.bashrc`, `.idea/`, `.vscode/`, `.mcp.json`, `.zshrc`, `CLAUDE.local.md` and similar dotfiles. I can't tell whether the last two were already there when I started.

The full handback is at `docs/delivery/handbacks/DG5/T-DG5-BE-A-backend-workflow-engineer.md`.
